name: unknown-version-0x04
description: Version byte 0x04 — the NEXT version, which does not exist yet. A v3 decoder must refuse it as firmly as it refuses v1 and v2: forwards-leniency is how a future field addition gets silently misread, and refusing an unrecognised successor is exactly what makes introducing a v4 safe. Paired with the two retired-version cases so the gate is symmetric in both directions.
expectedError: unknown version 4, want 3 (a higher version is refused, never best-effort decoded)
